name: Bisection Isosurface Extraction
definition: Implementation of the isosurface computation method in an in-house post-processing BEM software using C# and .NET, focusing on testing accuracy and resources rather than performance optimization.
summary: Bisection Isosurface Extraction is a meshfree method that decouples field evaluation from meshing, using an octree and bisection line search to locate isosurfaces with reduced computational cost.
